message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover for "TEMPO," dated "14-20 JANUARI 2019." The top features the gold-colored title "TEMPO" above the text "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Above this, white text reads "LAPORAN KHUSUS: TOKOH SENI 2018." Bold white text in the center reads "PURA-PURA SEPAK BOLA," followed by smaller yellow text.

The illustration depicts several figures in business suits around a curved gambling table. The tabletop is green and marked like a soccer field, featuring white lines, a center circle, and goal area markings. Two red dice with white dots rest on this surface. Various hands interact over the table: one hand in a white glove holds a fan of gold-colored bills; another hand holds a white carton; two hands hold drinking glasses—one with red liquid, another with green; several hands manipulate red gambling chips stacked on the table’s edge. One hand wearing a white glove places a single red chip. The figures are partially visible, showing only their arms, hands, and torsos in dark and light-colored suits. A barcode and price information are in the bottom-left corner.
